results.content: • • PSSC was able to secure two externally-funded projects, both from the Department of Science and Technology (DOST): DOST-Science and Education Institute’s (SEI) “Significant Change Stories of Participants of the Various Programs of DOST-SEI,” and the DOST-PCHRD “Mainstreaming Ethics in Human Participant Research: Perspectives and Practices of Social Science Research Organizations and Researchers in the Philippines.” • • For its international linkages and collaboration, PSSC remained committed to the International Science Council (ISC), Association of Asian Social Science Research Councils (AASSREC), and Science Council of Asia (SCA). 21-12-04 Approved the recommendation of the Membership Committee to accept the following institutions to be PSSC Associate Members: MSU-IIT College of Arts and Social Sciences; Universidad de Zamboanga Research and Devel-opment Center, and the Philippine Future’s Thinking Society.

results.title: 2024 NPC Annual Report
results.content: ROXAS, DBA President and CEO 4 2024 NPC ANNUAL REPORT Ensured the Structural and Operational Safety of Dams to Mitigate Flooding in the Downstream Communities Provided Efficient and Reliable Power Supply in Missionary Areas Contributed to Efficient Operation of Generation Assets in the Main Grids thru the Agus-Pulangi Plants Sustained System Reliability and Power Quality and Supported Load Growth Adopted the Use of Renewable Energy in Missionary Areas Consolidation of Ownership of NPC Assets/Property Boundaries/Tenurial Rights Charter Statement and Strategy Map Contributed to the Power Supply and Total Electrification in Missionary Areas Contributed to the Power Supply in the Main Grids thru the Agus-Pulangi Plants Ensured Customer/ Stakeholder Satisfaction Exercised Fiscal Prudence to Optimize Use of Resources Ensured Adequate Fund Sources for Sustainability and Improve Corporate Liquidity Ensured Employee Productivity and Competency OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE GOOD GOVERNANCE CORE VALUES: • Professionalism • Integrity • Service • Innovation SOCIAL IMPACT CUSTOMER/ STAKEHOLDER INTERNAL PROCESS FINANCIAL LEARNING & GROWTH MISSION National Power Corporation is committed to: • Provide reliable power generation and its associated power delivery systems to ensure total electrification of missionary areas while encouraging private sector participation; • Manage its watershed and dam operations to support power generation; • Operate and maintain the Agus and Pulangi hydroelectric power plants; and • Adopt innovative power technologies and business processes to respond to customer needs.
